about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Passion for motorcycles for years
about.storyText: Tornado Racing Moto was born from a passion for motorcycles and the desire to offer riders high-quality parts and accessories. What started as a small project is now a trusted partner for motorcycle enthusiasts across Europe.
about.missionText: We strive to offer every customer the best motorcycle parts at fair prices. Quality, reliability, and first-class customer service are our top priorities.
about.qualityText: We only offer inspected parts whose origin we know.
about.expertiseText: Our team consists of experienced motorcycle experts who provide competent advice.
about.serviceText: Fast delivery, easy returns, and personal support are a matter of course for us.
about.teamText: Behind Tornado Racing Moto is a dedicated team of motorcycle enthusiasts who have turned their passion into a profession.
about.lead: Motorcycle parts, advice and individual quotes – in German, English and Polish.
